Publication 131 — Withholding Income Tax Payment and Filing Requirements

employeeInputs.source: IL-W-6 or time and attendance system
IL-W-6 or time and attendance system

calculation.missingInvalidOrDisregardedCertificate: Withhold from the entire compensation with zero allowances.
calculation.tableAndFormulaDifference: The published wage-bracket tables group wages into ranges; the optional exact formula can therefore differ slightly from the table result.

supplementalCompensation.capturedRule: These items are employee compensation subject to Illinois withholding; no separate 2026 supplemental flat-rate method was located in the captured publications.

residencyAndWorkRules.localization: Compensation is paid in Illinois when all service is in Illinois or out-of-state service is incidental to principally Illinois service.
residencyAndWorkRules.residentFallback: When compensation is not localized under the primary rules, an Illinois resident is subject to Illinois withholding if no other state's tax is withheld.
residencyAndWorkRules.thresholdEffect: For significant nonincidental Illinois service exceeding 30 working days, allocate compensation by Illinois working days divided by total working days.

captureWarnings: The official HTML formula does not state a rounding sequence; table and formula results may differ because tables use wage ranges.
No distinct supplemental-wage calculation was located; bonus, overtime, and commission are identified as ordinary employee compensation.
The complete wage-bracket matrix is represented by its official source and example, not duplicated into this source capture.

review.requiredNextStep: Verify formula rounding and supplemental-pay treatment, compare calculated results to boundary rows in every published payroll table, and add executable engine cases before activation.
